subject: general
question: The SAHAY scheme to promote sports in rebel hit areas was launched by which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hemant Soren**, the chief minister of** Jharkhand**, introduced the "SAHAY" scheme from **Kolhan's Dhara** on **December 15, 2021.**
 
• It was started with the intention of **promoting sports and athletic skill.**
 
• 'SAHAY' stands for "**Sports Action Towards Harnessing Aspiration of Youths" scheme.**
 
• This SAHAY scheme will be operated by the** Sports Department.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SAHAY scheme's goal **is to inspire young people in** Naxal-affected communities **to live a good life by providing them a **sense of identity** via sports.
 
• In the initial round of the program,** 72,000 teenagers** between the ages of **14 and 19 **would have the chance to demonstrate their **athletic prowess.**
 
• These kids will be** **from the **Naxal-affected districts** of **Chaibasa, Seraikela-Kharsawan, Khunti, Gumla, and Simdega.**
 
• Young people with athletic talent up to the **Panchayat, Ward, Block, and District level**s will have the chance to demonstrate their abilities in various sports including** hockey, football, volleyball, and athletics.**
